title: spec ops: the line
text: Spec Ops: The Line is a completely unspectacular 3rd person shooter with an incredibly spectacular story.  The gameplay mechanics are tired and true, but the voice acting (notably Nolan North famously known as Drake from Uncharted) is refreshing and award worthy.  The story is dark, sharp, and twisted, and while the ending feels a touch rushed, the journey is expertly crafted.  I can't recommend this experience enough, even at full price.  Do yourself a favor and pick up one of the most underappreciated narratives in the last five years.

title: spec ops: the line
text: I hate the yes/ no review system but anyway: Story: Good but confusing till the end, I won't ruin anything but your along for the ride; it's not a RPG you don't get to pick which side of the fence your on or whether you want to sit on it.  Your job is to keep him alive to see story unfold. Visuals: looks great, but a lot of the effort they've put into the environments may go unnoticed. Gameplay: Realism: Not at all, one frustrating factor is you have limited ammo which is a realistic factor; but facing dozens of bad guys in one battle with some of them requiring you to empty a magazine on them isn't. You are in control of your squad to an extent, but unlike say Mass Effect you can't tell them to take cover at specific point or cover an area, all you can command is for them to kill someone.  So when they plough on ahead while you face a battalion and they get mowed down, you have to give them first aid to get them going again and if you don't they die then you're back to the last check point. I can imagine this game in an arcade with some pimply teenage boy sinking plenty of coins in just to get past one point.  I found battle scenes long and tedious. The battle scenes really let this game down for me, after retrying some scenes dozens of times and refusing to decrease the difficulty by the time it was time for the story to unfold I just didn’t care. I imagine the story is meant to be provocative, but for me the gameplay ruined this game (Hanging of the side of a truck with a grenade launcher shooting dozens of enemies, pfft) the unbelievable gameplay for me made the story unbelievable and unengaging

title: spec ops: the line
text: Is this game revolutionary? No, its a simple rail shooter. Is it graphically amazing? Not really, pretty standard. Does it do anything unique as far as game mechanics? No its pretty much a run of the mill squad based action game.....that being said I was pleasantly surprised by how much fun I was having playing this game. I went in expecting a PRO AMERICA - SUPER SOLDIER KILL TERRORISTS FTW shooter and came out pleasantly surprised by the dark and deep story that is presented. The premise is a little silly, but the tone and story play out very well and become nothing like the PRO WAR COD/BATTLEFIELD GUN FEST I was expecting. The game has some strange animations, and the controls are a little weak (cover and run are the same button for instance) but overall was still a solid and fun shooter to play. Also NOLAN NORTH!!

text: If you love adventure/exploration puzzle games, you will love this game! Beautiful graphics, easy game play, original concept (which is refreshing in todays world of re-makes), and totaly fun! The game is also clean, with only some slight potty humor (one of the dolls farts) so it's safe for kids (my 7 and 5 year-olds love this game)! I finished all the way through, and I think I'm addicted now! Well worth the price, in my opinion! In the game, you play as a little Russian nesting doll. You have to stack into other nesting dolls of varying talents, to solve puzzles, in order to thwart the Baron, and save your family and all the kids in your world. The game has a steampunk-ish vibe to it, and an old silent film theme; which means theres no voice acting, only subtitles, so you'll need to be a decent reader (not a bad thing in my opinion!) in order to really understand what's going on or where to go. The puzzles themselves wher not hard, but creatively fun to figure out; and there's hints given, ranging from subtle to "dead give-a-way", for each one in case you get stuck! Soundtrack was lovely, and the visuals were beautiful! Overall a fantastic game, and a new family favorite for us!
